title: Core meaning: narrow
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: The path beside the reservoir was so ___ that the hikers had to walk in single file.

choice_rationales.A: Slight means small in amount or degree, not limited from side to side.
choice_rationales.B: Narrow precisely describes a path with too little width for people to walk side by side.
choice_rationales.C: Thin usually describes limited thickness or a person or object with little breadth, not the usable width of this path.
choice_rationales.D: Cramped describes an uncomfortably confined space, usually one occupied or used inside; the sentence specifies path width instead.

parts.hint: Which option names limited width, the feature proved by walking in single file?
parts.correct_explanation: The single-file evidence identifies limited width, so ‘narrow’ is more precise than words that mean small in degree, thickness or roominess.
